title: Sherlock 2.3 is here!
release_notes:
### 🔄 Username Permutations & Smart Input
• One toggle scans separator variants: john.doe → john_doe, john-doe, johndoe
• Paste any profile URL into the search bar — the handle is extracted for you
• Pasted values auto-extract into the engine's multi-target list

### 🗓 Profile Dates Humanized
• Join/created dates render as 'Apr 2019' on cards, dossiers, and reports
• ISO, unix, and platform-specific formats parsed; unreadable values stay raw
• HTML dossier gains a custom Jinja date filter alongside the core CSS base

### 📧 Email Scans, More Honest
• Single backoff retry through rate limits — landed results are barely slower
• Cancels now always mark the scan: fixed a wakeup-window race that lost 5 of 6
• Gravatar fallback avatars for every email address in the dossier

### ⚙ Settings & Build
• New permutations toggle under Scan Parameters
• Database stats header: networks and tag counts at a glance on the sites screen
• Full ruff rule suite (S/TRY/BLE/EM/A/SIM/RET/RSE) with documented exceptions
• Ad subsystem, banners, and consent flow completely untouched per owner rule
